title: MKS’ Atotech to highlight advanced surface finishing solutions at Industry Expo Romania

29. Oct 2026 | Tradeshows and events


# MKS’ Atotech to highlight advanced surface finishing solutions at Industry Expo Romania


**Berlin, October 29, 2026 –** MKS Inc. (NASDAQ: MKSI), a global provider of enabling technologies that transform our world, will participate in Industry Expo Romania on November 5, marking the company’s first appearance at the event. Visitors will have the opportunity to meet with MKS’ Atotech experts and learn how integrated surface finishing technologies can help manufacturers address evolving technical, economic, and regulatory challenges across a wide range of industrial markets.


A highlight of the event will be the presentation “Surface finishing in transition: turning market challenges into performance, resilience and growth”, taking place at 9:40-10 am. The session will explore how evolving chemical requirements, electrification, renewable energy, and the growing use of aluminum are reshaping the plating industry.


The presentation will examine how efficient process technologies, early qualification of alternative chemical pathways, multifunctional coatings, and substrate-specific pretreatment solutions can help manufacturers respond to these changes.


Additionally, at booth 19, MKS’ Atotech will showcase surface finishing technologies supporting applications across automotive, construction, appliances, furniture, industrial manufacturing, energy, and other key markets.


**Event:** Industry Expo Romania
**Date:** November 5, 2026
**Booth:** 19
**Venue:** Expovest Timisoara


For more information, please visit:[https://industryexpo.intradefairs.com/](https://industryexpo.intradefairs.com/) .
